caption: The drawing depicts a wooden sewing table with four slender, turned legs and a rectangular top with slightly chamfered corners. The table is made up of warm brown wood, and the surface of the tabletop is decorated with a starburst or sunburst pattern. The front of the table has two horizontal drawers, each fitted with two round, brass-colored handles. Below the drawers, there is a gathered, pleated fabric bag that hangs down between the legs, appearing to be off-white or pale beige in color with vertical patterns printed or embroidered on it. The drawing shows the table in full detail, in a three-quarters perspective against a plain, light tan background. In the lower right corner, the name “F. Choate” is written, likely indicating the artist.
title: Sewing Table
